description.en: Agent presets packaged as a plugin: installing it registers "鲸鱼娘Agent预设", "鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设" and "鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设" (Whale Girl) in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown with no hand-edited config. Each preset is the official minimal composition (shell only) plus file tools, a whale-girl persona and its own persistent memory file, injected as a prompt variable so it is read before the first reply. Each preset also ships a dedicated write tool (whale_memory_add / whale_memory_v2_add / whale_memory_v3_add) that appends one-line rolling summaries, so the memory keeps growing instead of freezing at whatever was written by hand. The three presets are fully isolated: different memory file, different prompt variable, different write tool.
description.zh: 把 Agent 预设打包成插件：装上就在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设」，在模式下拉里直接选用，不用手改配置。每个预设都是官方极简模式的组成（只含 shell）加文件工具、鲸鱼娘人设和自己的一份持久记忆文件，记忆经提示变量注入，第一句话之前就读到。每个预设还自带一条专用写入工具（whale_memory_add / whale_memory_v2_add / whale_memory_v3_add），把每轮的一行摘要追加进去，记忆会自己长，不会停在手写那几条。三个预设完全隔离：记忆文件不同、提示变量不同、写入工具也不同。
